info.title: zx-panel
info.description: Single-server Linux panel. Every JSON write rejects duplicate/unknown/case-alias keys and trailing values (1 MiB maximum). Cookies: HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, Secure in production; preauth 10 min, idle 30 min, absolute 12 h. Bearer tokens are not accepted. Unavailable metrics are null. Full production acceptance requires Linux/systemd evidence.
